valid_future_comparison_requirements: For default-profile efficacy, invoke the actual default profile and allow its complete responsibilities to finish before comparing outcome and total resource use.
For a controlled configuration, declare the N/T/R/S/D/V/L/M choices in the function header before execution, run that declared configuration to completion, and freeze the control beforehand.
